purpose: Private reviewed source for staged release; NEVER copy to dist.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 2000ml Gradient Large Capacity Water Bottle with Carry Handle
reviews.author: Rachel Dunmore
reviews.reviewBody: Ordered 600 pcs for our summer gym push. Handle is the main reason we chose it, holds up fine with 2L in it. Sold about half in the first month.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 800ml Clear Sports Water Bottle with Carry Loop
reviews.author: Jonas Becker
reviews.reviewBody: Loop was stiff on sample #1. Told them, got a revised one in about a week and it was better. Fine now.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 1300ml Gradient Compact Water Jug with Carry Handle
reviews.author: Layla Haddad
reviews.reviewBody: Nice size for desks. Customers keep calling it 'the little jug'. Carton info was clear so no guessing on the container.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 1300ml Illustrated Clear Compact Water Jug with Carry Handle
reviews.author: Camille Dubois
reviews.reviewBody: Went with the illustrated one for a gift set. Artwork lined up well. Took longer than the plain model, but they said so at the start.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 1000ml Gradient Sports Water Bottle with Time Markers
reviews.author: Ethan Brooks
reviews.reviewBody: Time markers = easy sell for our 30-day water challenge. Print didn't come off when we rubbed it with a wet cloth. Reordering.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 1000ml Clear Sports Water Bottle with Time Markers
reviews.author: Ingrid Solheim
reviews.reviewBody: Clear body, customers like it. Wish there were more lid colours. Bulk matched the sample.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 1000ml Flip-Top Sports Water Bottle with Time Markers
reviews.author: Mateo Silva
reviews.reviewBody: Flip-top works one-handed. Filled 30 pcs, upside down for an hour, zero drips. OK for the price.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 1300ml Gradient Compact Water Jug with Carry Strap
reviews.author: Oliver Grant
reviews.reviewBody: Strap is comfy, good for beach season. A bit bulky on shelves so we asked for a different carton. Otherwise happy.

reviews.author: Fatima Zahra El Idrissi
reviews.reviewBody: Straw + flip lid is what people ask for on the commute. Easy to clean with a straw brush. Cartons arrived intact.

reviews.productSourceTitle: Gradient Sports Bottles with Time Markers
reviews.author: Lukas Novak
reviews.reviewBody: Gradient colours were consistent across the batch, which I was worried about. Replies slowed down around holiday time but nothing serious.

reviews.author: Sarah Whitfield
reviews.reviewBody: Used these in a back-to-school bundle. Gone in three weeks.

reviews.author: Victor Mensah
reviews.reviewBody: Strong handle, fits a whole training session. Sea freight took 5 weeks, within what they quoted.

reviews.productSourceTitle: Gradient Sports Bottles with Carry Loops
reviews.author: Nina Petrova
reviews.reviewBody: Loop clips onto bags nicely. Samples shipped fast. Gradient looks good on the shelf.

reviews.productSourceTitle: Clear Sports Bottles with Carry Rings
reviews.author: Hiroshi Mori
reviews.reviewBody: Clean finish, I can't see mold lines. Only comment: the packing insert could be thinner, we lose carton space.

reviews.author: Elena Rossi
reviews.reviewBody: Small flip-top bottles go well with women's gym classes. Photographs nicely for our webshop too.

reviews.author: Samuel Adeyemi
reviews.reviewBody: First shipment had a few scuffed bottles from rough carton handling. They replaced them with the next order, no drama. Ask for extra protection if shipping far.

reviews.author: Daniel Reuter
reviews.reviewBody: Ordered 20 samples before committing to a full run. Wall thickness was consistent across all of them and not a single lid weeped in our tilt test. Replies were usually same-day. We're moving to a 3,000 pc first order.

reviews.author: Priya Nair
reviews.reviewBody: Good bottle for gym bundles. The 750ml sells better than the 550 in our market. It took one extra round of emails to agree the carton configuration, but the shipment then matched the confirmed sample. Would like more color options.

reviews.author: Marcus Webb
reviews.reviewBody: We used this for a corporate wellness giveaway with a one-color logo. The print was sharp and the proof matched what arrived. Packing was tidy and nothing was scuffed. Recommended for promo buyers.

reviews.author: Anika Schreiber
reviews.reviewBody: Came in a mixed sample box. Lid fit and finish were tidy. Model number on the carton made reordering simple.

reviews.author: Brandon Hayes
reviews.reviewBody: 1.2L is what our powerlifting gyms want. Doesn't flex when full. Packed well.

reviews.author: Mei-Ling Chua
reviews.reviewBody: Right size for small hands and school bags. A few parents said the lid is easy for kids to open. No cracks in our 800 pcs.

reviews.author: Isabella Moretti
reviews.reviewBody: Sold into schools for the new term. Colours are fun, a bit glossy for my taste. Asked for a calmer palette next time and they were fine with it.

reviews.author: Sofia Marín
reviews.reviewBody: Solid everyday bottle, sold well to schools and sports clubs. Colors are bright. Our first sample had slight gloss variation between two colors, so we asked for a golden sample before mass production and they handled it without fuss.

reviews.author: Tariq Mahmood
reviews.reviewBody: Good everyday size. Price came down a bit once we agreed quantity. Arrived 3 days later than estimated but they told us beforehand.

reviews.author: Kenji Arai
reviews.reviewBody: Our QC is strict. I checked 50 pieces from the shipment for seams, lid threads and fit, and the defect rate was lower than with our previous supplier. Delivery was two days ahead of the agreed date.

reviews.author: Greta Keller
reviews.reviewBody: Litre bottles are our autumn best-seller. Threads are clean, walls even. No loose lids out of the box.

reviews.author: Amara Okafor
reviews.reviewBody: Bottle itself is fine and customers like the size. Production took longer than I had planned for, so I'd advise new buyers to order early and confirm the schedule in writing. Quality was acceptable and they were honest about the delay.

reviews.author: Diego Ramírez
reviews.reviewBody: Used for football academies. Logo survived repeated washing in our test. One carton had a small dent, nothing major.

reviews.author: Ahmed Farouk
reviews.reviewBody: Sells well in summer. Quality has been steady over two orders and they answer technical questions quickly.

reviews.author: Tomás Herrera
reviews.reviewBody: Bought for a brewery's merchandise line. The shape suited their branding well. We needed replacement lids for part of the order and they quoted spares separately, which was helpful. Shipping to South America took a while but the packing held up.

reviews.author: Hannah Lindqvist
reviews.reviewBody: The clear body lets parents see how much their kid has had to drink, which our customers like. A smaller size is easy for children to hold. Sample arrived well packed and we confirmed the order within a week.

reviews.author: Oskari Virtanen
reviews.reviewBody: Stays clear, no cloudiness on our samples. 650ml is a good commuter size.

reviews.author: Tom Fraser
reviews.reviewBody: Perfect for camping and clubs. Wide opening is easy to fill and clean. Feels robust.

reviews.author: Mads Jensen
reviews.reviewBody: Good capacity, easy refill. Handle fine. The master carton is big so freight per piece was higher than I expected.

reviews.author: Carla Mendes
reviews.reviewBody: Gym customers wanted an all-day jug. 2.2L does it and it stands stable. Already reordered.

reviews.author: Peter Kovač
reviews.reviewBody: Seals well when closed. Carton labels were clear. Would like another colour in the line.

reviews.author: Jim Kowalski
reviews.reviewBody: Gallon size is a hit with our fitness crowd. Handle feels strong, no leaks in transit.

reviews.author: Raúl Benítez
reviews.reviewBody: Big and sturdy, measurement lines are useful. Shipped a bit later than planned, quality good though.

reviews.author: Daan de Vries
reviews.reviewBody: Clean design, sells well in store. Logo came out exactly like the proof. Replies were quick.

reviews.author: Nadia Karim
reviews.reviewBody: Stylish for gym buyers. Couple of units with tiny cosmetic marks, replaced without fuss.

reviews.author: Andre Lacroix
reviews.reviewBody: We used these for corporate team events. Size and handle suit that well. Delivered on the date promised.

reviews.author: Grace Wanjiru
reviews.reviewBody: Good for offices and gyms, price fair. Colour on screen vs real was slightly off, so confirm a colour reference first.

reviews.author: Piotr Zielinski
reviews.reviewBody: 1.5L seems to be the sweet spot, a lot of customers prefer it to 2L. Cap closes firmly.

reviews.author: Balázs Szabó
reviews.reviewBody: Big but not heavy when empty. A sleeve option would help for retail.

reviews.author: Chloe Martin
reviews.reviewBody: Small size works for kids' sport clubs and lunch bags. Cheerful colours. Lids were fine in our check.

reviews.author: Andrei Popescu
reviews.reviewBody: Practical daily size. Packed neatly, model number easy to cross-check. Samples could be faster.

reviews.author: Karen Liu
reviews.reviewBody: Third order of this one. Consistent each time and they remember our packing preferences.

reviews.author: Jorge Castillo
reviews.reviewBody: Decent litre bottle for the money. We had a couple of customs paperwork corrections on our side, the team helped sort it.

reviews.author: Megan Doyle
reviews.reviewBody: Gym members like the big capacity. Feels well made, nothing rattled or leaked in testing.

reviews.author: Ali Demir
reviews.reviewBody: Reliable. Logo placement matched the proof but the colour was a touch lighter than our reference. Noted for next time.

reviews.author: Julia Wagner
reviews.reviewBody: Good for older primary kids who outgrow small bottles. No sharp edges on the samples.

reviews.author: Anna Kowalczyk
reviews.reviewBody: Best-selling kids' bottle for us this season. Parents like the size and colours, no complaints after a month.

reviews.author: Emily Foster
reviews.reviewBody: Each bottle individually bagged, which parents appreciated. Fun colours and the lid feels well made.

reviews.author: Valentina Cruz
reviews.reviewBody: Nice proportions for children. First sample lid was a bit tight, fixed for production.

reviews.author: Hana Suzuki
reviews.reviewBody: Neat finish, right size for kindergarten. No scratches on arrival.

reviews.author: Mariam Al Suwaidi
reviews.reviewBody: Good for school-supplies season. On time. Would like one more bright colour.

reviews.author: Beatriz Santos
reviews.reviewBody: Sells well next to our stationery. Looks cute and feels sturdy. They were patient with all my questions.

reviews.author: Thomas Hall
reviews.reviewBody: Decent bottle but two cartons arrived dented. Bottles fine though, and they offered a small credit on the next order.

reviews.author: Ricardo Alves
reviews.reviewBody: Good quality for the price. Sold through to several local gyms with good feedback.

reviews.author: Katarina Horvat
reviews.reviewBody: Bought for school sports teams. Big for a kids' bottle but they like not refilling. Survived our drop test.

reviews.author: Jamal Carter
reviews.reviewBody: Solid mid-size for gym bags, matte finish hides scuffs. Slow answers on custom colour questions.

reviews.author: Sandra Gruber
reviews.reviewBody: Clean lines and good weight. Customers say it feels more premium than the price.

reviews.author: Mohamed Salem
reviews.reviewBody: Good jug for hot climates. We ordered mixed colours and the assortment matched what we agreed.

reviews.author: Tony Russo
reviews.reviewBody: Exactly the big size our bodybuilding customers want. Sturdy, easy to fill, easy to carry.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 1600ml Large Capacity Plastic Water Jug (Transparent Variant)
reviews.author: Lukas Petrauskas
reviews.reviewBody: Clear body makes tracking daily intake easy. Looks clean, good as a gift item.

reviews.author: Erin Walsh
reviews.reviewBody: Great for family camping, wide opening is easy to clean, cap seals firmly.

reviews.author: Kwame Asante
reviews.reviewBody: Big capacity and good price per litre. Slightly slower delivery than hoped but goods matched the order.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 1600ml Large Capacity Plastic Water Jug (Transparent Variant)
reviews.author: Tereza Dvořáková
reviews.reviewBody: Looks great on display shelves. Clean finish, no customer complaints.

reviews.productSourceTitle: 2400ml Large Capacity Plastic Water Jug (Transparent Variant)
reviews.author: Diana Lopez
reviews.reviewBody: Customers like seeing how much they drank during workouts. A printed measurement scale option would be welcome.

reviews.author: Bruno Costa
reviews.reviewBody: Practical size for every day, comfortable handle. Customers come back for more.

reviews.author: Sophie Laurent
reviews.reviewBody: Good value for this size. Sample lid was slightly stiff but loosened with use.

reviews.author: Yuna Park
reviews.reviewBody: Right size for kids' lunch bags. Bright colours, smooth finish, careful packing.

reviews.author: Olivia Bennett
reviews.reviewBody: Popular for back-to-school. A couple of colours sold faster, so we changed the mix on reorder.

reviews.author: Noor Rahman
reviews.reviewBody: Good starter size for little ones. Reasonable price, sample matched the production run.

reviews.author: Camila Torres
reviews.reviewBody: Parents like how light it is. Put it in a school promo and it moved fast.

reviews.author: Lucas Almeida
reviews.reviewBody: Good looking and comfortable for children. Would like more flexibility on small custom colour runs.

reviews.author: Freya Johansson
reviews.reviewBody: Compact size suits preschoolers. No issues in our usual leak and drop checks.

reviews.author: Nikos Papadakis
reviews.reviewBody: Nice in-between size, sells well in summer. Solid build.

reviews.author: Ivana Marković
reviews.reviewBody: Good for gym customers who want a litre and a bit more. Handle feels secure, fair price.

reviews.author: David Cohen
reviews.reviewBody: Great for long days outdoors. Packed carefully, shipping updates were clear.

reviews.author: Rosa Delgado
reviews.reviewBody: Good large bottle, tidy finish, lid fits well. A few more colours would be nice.

reviews.author: Jin Wei Tan
reviews.reviewBody: Reliable quality, quick sample turnaround. Reordered twice, same spec each time.

reviews.author: Eric Holm
reviews.reviewBody: Solid bottle. Only hiccup was a port delay, not the supplier's fault. Good communication.

reviews.author: Aiko Sato
reviews.reviewBody: Clean, simple design that parents like. Lid fits properly, neat packaging.

reviews.author: Nathan Cole
reviews.reviewBody: Used for a branded giveaway. Print quality good. Send vector artwork early to avoid revisions.

reviews.author: Pooja Mehta
reviews.reviewBody: Good value, consistent. Ordered a few thousand, only a handful of cosmetic rejects.

reviews.author: Hugo Lambert
reviews.reviewBody: Big jug that feels sturdy. Gym customers like the capacity and it was well protected in transit.

reviews.author: Derek Shaw
reviews.reviewBody: Ball mixes powder without much clumping and the lid is secure. Supplement customers asked for more after batch one.

reviews.author: Alicia Gomez
reviews.reviewBody: 700ml is the size customers prefer for post-workout shakes. Measurement scale print was clear. Delivery a little slow.

reviews.author: Marko Babić
reviews.reviewBody: Good compact shaker for gym bags. Smooth mixing, lid easy to open and close.

reviews.author: Chloe Anderson
reviews.reviewBody: Small size is popular with our women's fitness customers. Easy to clean, cap threads smoothly.

reviews.author: Ravi Shankar
reviews.reviewBody: Practical and affordable for supplement bundles. A few whisk balls needed a second look in QC, supplier replaced them.

reviews.author: Tyler Reed
reviews.reviewBody: Like having two sizes in one family. Mixes well, logo print held up in washing tests.

reviews.author: Gabriela Ortiz
reviews.reviewBody: Customers like the size choice. Good quality, would like a wider colour range for retail.

reviews.author: Peter Lang
reviews.reviewBody: Simple clean bottle, good for branding. Print sharp, client very pleased.

reviews.author: Emma Clarke
reviews.reviewBody: Good for gift sets. Careful packaging; get a physical sample before choosing a colour.

reviews.author: Pablo Núñez
reviews.reviewBody: Practical everyday size. Steady repeat orders, no complaints.

reviews.author: Sara Nasser
reviews.reviewBody: Nice finish and comfortable grip. A bit slower than hoped but complete and accurate.

reviews.author: William Tran
reviews.reviewBody: Good capacity at a competitive price. Helped us pick carton packing to cut freight cost.

reviews.author: Annika Berg
reviews.reviewBody: Neat bottle for commuters and gym. Lid fit was good on every piece checked.
